basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old aspiring motorcyclist from Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the thrill of two wheels. During the day, I work as a graphic designer for a local advertising firm, but my evenings and weekends are devoted to learning more about motorcycle gear and safe riding practices. I'm single and enjoy exploring new technologies and gadgets, especially those related to my new motorcycling hobby. My typical online hours are in the evenings, after dinner, when I have time to unwind and catch up with the Reddit community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts, which I pursued in college, and I've always had an interest in design and aesthetics. My knowledge about motorcycles is growing steadily through online research, community forums, and beginner riding courses. I am also keen on learning about investment and personal finance through subreddits such as 'RobinhoodYachtClub'.
